name: cc-bridge
description: CC-Bridge — Claude Code upstream bridge framework (GLM / DeepSeek / MiMo / Kimi / Qwen …). Routes Claude Code to third-party models via spoofed whitelist IDs, pins per-model thinking levels via config (CC's /effort doesn't affect the upstream), and fails over across multiple API keys. GLM / DeepSeek / MiMo adapters included.
